full_judgment: Latifur Rahman J: Petitioner filed Revocation Case No. 144 of 1975 in the Court of District Judge, Mymensingh against granting of Probate in Probate Case No. 2 of 1967 of the Court of District Judge, Mymensingh. The said Revocation case was disallowed on the ground that the petitioner had no locus standi to file the revocation case. Against that judgment and order the petitioner preferred First Appeal No. 40 of 1977 and the same was dismissed by a Division Bench of the high court Division on 29-3-1993, Petitioner is now seeking leave to appeal from the impugned judgment of the High Court Division.
